title: Why August 23 may be a big day for global markets
dc:creator: CNBCTV18
content: Situated at an average altitude of 6,000 feet in the Rocky Mountains, Jackson Hole is a top tourist destination for camping, skiing and agrotourism. This settlement in Wyoming - the least populated US state - is also known as the 'Davos for central bankers'. It is here that global central bankers, economists, financial market participants and policymakers will meet between August 22 and 24 this year to discuss the most pressing economic issues. What Fed chair Jerome Powell said in 2022 led to a big sell-off. His next speech on Friday (Aug 23) will be an important one to watch.
